67405.commentary: (DNa) vighāsasaṃvaḍḍho'ti vighāsena saṃvaḍḍho, vighāsaṃ bhakkhitā tirittamaṃsaṃ khāditvā vaḍḍhito. (DNa) attānaṃ vighāse samekkhiyā'ti soṇḍiyaṃ ucchiṭṭh'odake thūlaṃ attabhāvaṃ disvā.

examples.text: aññaṃ anucaṅkamanaṃ, attānaṃ vighāse samekkhiya, yāva attānaṃ na passati, kotthu tāva byaggho'ti maññati.

67406.meaning1: enlarged on the remains; grown fat on the scraps (of)
67406.commentary: (DNa) vighāsasaṃvaḍḍho'ti vighāsena saṃvaḍḍho, vighāsaṃ bhakkhitā tirittamaṃsaṃ khāditvā vaḍḍhito.

examples.text: tass'eva kho, āvuso pāthikaputta, sīhassa migarañño vighāsasaṃvaḍḍho jarasiṅgālo ditto c'eva balavā ca.

67407.meaning2: who eats the remains of food

67409.commentary: (SNPa) subhāsitadubbhāsitaññutāya vicakkhaṇo eva labhati, na itaro. ten'āha appamatto vicakkhaṇo'ti.

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, paṇḍiteh'atthadassibhi, atthaṃ mahantaṃ gambhīraṃ, duddasaṃ nipuṇaṃ aṇuṃ, dhīrā samadhigacchanti, appamattā vicakkhaṇā'ti.
ty'āssa sīlavato sīlaṃ, cāgaṃ sucaritāni ca, passamān'ānukubbanti, attam'atthaṃ vicakkhaṇā.

67410.meaning1: discerning person; wise one; insightful man

examples.text: ty'assa sīlavato sīlaṃ, cāgaṃ sucaritāni ca, passamān'ānukubbanti, ye bhavanti vicakkhaṇā.
sāsan'atthaṃ samuddiṭṭhaṃ, may'ākhyātaṃ samāsato, sakaṃ buddhivisesena, cintayantu vicakkhaṇā.

67411.meaning1: name of a group of deities
67411.meaning2: name of a group of deities
67411.commentary: (DNa) āguṃ devā vicakkhaṇā'ti vicakkhaṇā nāma devā āgatā.

examples.text: sukkā karambhā aruṇā, āguṃ veghanasā saha, odātagayhā pāmokkhā, āguṃ devā vicakkhaṇā.

67413.meaning1: blinding; causing confusion; pulling the wool over one's eyes
67413.commentary: (SNa) vicakkhukammāyā'ti parisāya paññācakkhuṃ vināsetu'kamyatāya. buddhānaṃ pan'esa paññācakkhuṃ vināsetuṃ na sakkoti, parisāya bherav'ārammaṇaṃ sāvento vā dassento vā sakkoti. (SNt) vicakkhukammāyā'ti vicakkhubhāvakāmatāya. yathā sā bhagavato desiyamānaṃ dhammaṃ attano paññācakkhunā na passituṃ sakkoti, evaṃ kātuṃ kāmatāya. ten'āha parisāyā'ti-ādi.

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyā'ti.
santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo'ti pajānāti

67415.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of vicaya
67415.commentary: (SNa) vicayaso'ti vicayena, tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvavicinanasamatthena ñāṇena paricchinditvā'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ vicayaso desito, bhikkhave, mayā dhammo. evaṃ vicayaso desite kho, bhikkhave, mayā dhamme atha ca pan'idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, kathaṃ nu kho jānato kathaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotī'ti?
yehi vivitto vicareyya loke, na tāni uggayha vadeyya nāgo, jal'ambujaṃ kaṇḍakaṃ vārijaṃ yathā, jalena paṅkena c'anūpalittaṃ, evaṃ munī santivādo agiddho, kāme ca loke ca anūpalitto.
saññāvirattassa na santi ganthā, paññāvimuttassa na santi mohā, saññañ'ca diṭṭhiñ'ca ye aggahesuṃ, te ghaṭṭayantā vicaranti loke'ti.
sa pattapāṇi vicaranto, amūgo mūgasammato, appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya, dātāraṃ n'āvajāniyā.
buddhā ca nāma pad'ānupadikaṃ vicarantena-api saṭhena ārādhetuṃ na sakkā
dhātiyo khajjabhojj'antare vicaramānā thokaṃ cirāyiṃsu, sesarukkhānaṃ chāyā nivattā, tassa pana rukkhassa parimaṇḍalā hutvā aṭṭhāsi.
saddhāya pabbajitvāna, agārasm'ānagāriyaṃ, vicariṃ'haṃ tena tena, lābhasakkāraussukā.
aṭṭhārasa kho pan'imāni, bhikkhave, taṇhāvicaritāni ajjhattikassa upādāya, aṭṭhārasa taṇhāvicaritāni bāhirassa upādāya.

67426.meaning1: to wander about; to go around

examples.text: āvuso, āgantuka kuṭumbikassa te gehe bhattaṃ bhuñjanato varataraṃ mīḷhaṃ khādituṃ… kuṭumbikena dinnasāṭakanivāsanato varataraṃ naggena vicarituṃ.
idh'āvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vitakko ca vattati, vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañ'ca citt'ek'aggatā ca. paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ evaṃ pañc'aṅgikan'ti.
vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
idh'āvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vitakko ca vattati, vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañ'ca citt'ek'aggatā ca. paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ evaṃ pañc'aṅgikan'ti.

67431.commentary: (ADha) ārammaṇe tena cittaṃ vicaratī'ti vicāro, vicaraṇaṃ vā vicāro. anusañcaraṇan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. sv'āyaṃ ārammaṇ'ānumajjanalakkhaṇo.

67434.commentary: (SNa) vicāraṇan'ti vicaraṇā pādāni. bahuvacane ekavacanaṃ kataṃ. vitakkassa vicāraṇan'ti vitakko tassa pādā. (SNt) vicaran'ti etehī'ti vicāraṇā, pādā.

examples.text: kiṃsu saṃyojano loko, kiṃsu tassa vicāraṇaṃ, kiss'assa vippahānena, nibbānaṃ iti vuccati.
nandīsaṃyojano loko, vitakkassa vicāraṇaṃ, taṇhāya vippahānena, nibbānaṃ iti vuccatī'ti.

67438.meaning1: with a measure of examination; with a modicum of exploration

examples.text: imaṃ samādhiṃ savitakkam'pi savicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi vicāramattaṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi avicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, sappītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, nippītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, sātasahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi, upekkhāsahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi.

67440.synonym: upaparikkhanta, pavicaranta, pavicinanta, vicinanta, vīmaṃsamāna, samannesanta, samannesamāna, samanvesanta

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhante, idh'ekacco na h'eva kho nimittena ādisati, n'āpi manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati. api ca kho vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati, evam'pi te mano, ittham'pi te mano, iti'pi te cittan'ti.
tayo vitakke kusale vitakkaye, tayo pana akusale nirākare, sa ve vitakkāni vicāritāni, sameti vuṭṭhī'va rajaṃ samūhataṃ.
asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi sabrahmacārīnaṃ cīvarakamme vicāritā

67443.synonym: upaparikkhati, upavicarati, paṭivicarati, pavicarati, pavicinati, vicināti, vīmaṃsati, samannesati, samanvesati

examples.text: so paṭisaṃharati c'eva na ca vitakketi na ca vicāreti

67445.meaning1: to manage; to arrange; to organize

67446.meaning1: having thought about; having pondered; having contemplated

examples.text: pubbe kho, gahapati, vitakketvā vicāretvā pacchā vācaṃ bhindati, tasmā vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro.

67448.meaning1: having managed; having arranged; having planned

67451.meaning1: who has removed doubt; who has cut off uncertainty

examples.text: etādisī dhammappakāsan'ettha, na tattha kiṃkaṅkhati koci sāvako, nitiṇṇa-oghaṃ vicikicchachinnaṃ, buddhaṃ namassāma jinaṃ jan'indaṃ.
dukkham'eva uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, dukkhaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ nirujjhatī'ti na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati aparapaccayā ñāṇam'ev'assa ettha hoti. ettāvatā kho, kaccāna, sammādiṭṭhi hoti.
yo so, sāriputta, ariyasāvako tathāgate ek'antagato abhippasanno, na so tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā'ti?

67454.synonym: āsaṅkā, kaṅkhā, kaṅkhitā, vicikicchitā, vimati, saṅkā
67454.commentary: (DNa) satthari kaṅkhatī'ti-ādinā nayena āgatā aṭṭhavatthukā vimati vicikicchā nāma. (MNa) asakkonto maggaṃ vā phalaṃ vā na pāpuṇātī'ti yathā kantār'addhānamagge corā atthi n'atthī'ti punappunaṃ āsappanaparisappanaṃ apariyogāhanaṃ chambhitatta cittassa uppādento khem'antapattiyā antarāyaṃ karoti, evaṃ vicikicchā'pi buddho nu kho na buddho'ti-ādinā nayena punappunaṃ āsappanaparisappanaṃ apariyogāhanaṃ chambhitattaṃ cittassa uppādayamānā ariyabhūmippattiyā antarāyaṃ karotī'ti kantār'addhānamaggo viya daṭṭhabbā. (THa) vicikicchā'ti, evaṃ nu kho na nu kho'ti saṃsayaṃ āpajjati, dhammasabhāvaṃ vā vicinanto kicchati kilamati etāyā'ti vicikicchā, buddh'ādivatthuko saṃsayo.

examples.text: idh'āvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti, byāpādo pahīno hoti, thīnamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti
tassa evaṃ yoniso manasikaroto tīṇi saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā dassanā pahātabbā

67455.meaning1: arrow of doubt and uncertainty; barb of uncertainty and confusion

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso, yaṃ asmī'ti vigate ayam'aham'asmī'ti asamanupassato, atha ca pan'assa vicikicchā-kathaṅ'kathā-sallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. nissaraṇaṃ h'etaṃ, āvuso, vicikicchā-kathaṅ'kathā-sallassa, yadidaṃ asmimānasamugghāto'ti.

67456.meaning1: arrow of doubt and uncertainty; barb of uncertainty and confusion

examples.text: idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, asmī'ti kho me vigataṃ, ayam'aham'asmī'ti ca na samanupassāmi, atha ca pana me vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.

67457.meaning1: serving as a basis for doubt; giving support to uncertainty
67457.commentary: (ITIa) vicikicchāṭṭhāniyesu dhammesu ayonisomanasikārena vicikicchāya uppādo hoti. vicikicchāṭṭhāniyā dhammā nāma punappunaṃ vicikicchāya kāraṇattā vicikicchāva. tattha ayonisomanasikāraṃ bahulaṃ pavattayato vicikicchā uppajjati.

examples.text: vicikicchāṭṭhāniyānaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ manasikārabahulīkārā anuppannā c'eva vicikicchā uppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati.

67458.meaning1: serving as a basis for doubt; giving support to uncertainty

examples.text: ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, vicikicchāṭṭhānīyā dhammā.

67459.meaning1: due to doubt; because of uncertainty

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, anuruddhā, etadahosi, vicikicchā kho me udapādi, vicikicch'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.

67460.meaning1: obstacle that is doubt; hindrance of uncertainty

examples.text: caṅgavāran'ti kho, bhikkhu, pañcann'etaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmacchandanīvaraṇassa, byāpādanīvaraṇassa, thīnamiddhanīvaraṇassa, uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇassa, vicikicchānīvaraṇassa.

67461.meaning1: underlying tendency to doubt; inherent inclination towards uncertainty

examples.text: kāmarāg'ānusayassa… paṭigh'ānusayassa… diṭṭh'ānusayassa… vicikicch'ānusayassa… mān'ānusayassa… bhavarāg'ānusayassa… avijj'ānusayassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
es'ev'anto paṭigh'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto diṭṭh'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto vicikicch'ānusayānaṃ

67462.meaning1: obsessed by doubt; consumed by uncertainty

examples.text: vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. so vicikicchaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.

sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhito hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhito hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu idhalokacintāya pasuto hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti.

67463.meaning1: afflicted with doubt; overcome by uncertainty

examples.text: vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. so vicikicchaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.

67464.meaning1: overcome by doubt; overpowered by uncertainty

examples.text: akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati. vicikicch'ābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti. akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.

67466.meaning1: bond of doubt; fetter of uncertainty

examples.text: satta saññojanāni, anunayasaññojanaṃ, paṭighasaññojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ, mānasaññojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaññojanaṃ, avijjāsaññojanaṃ.

67467.meaning1: bond of doubt; fetter of uncertainty

examples.text: satta saṃyojanāni, anunayasaṃyojanaṃ, paṭighasaṃyojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaṃyojanaṃ, mānasaṃyojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaṃyojanaṃ, avijjāsaṃyojanaṃ.

67468.meaning1: who helps to cross beyond doubt

examples.text: yadā ca buddham'addakkhiṃ, vicikicchāvitāraṇaṃ, so'mhi vītabhayo ajja, sambuddhaṃ payirupāsiya.

67470.synonym: āsaṅkā, kaṅkhitā, dveḷhaka, vicikicchitā, vicchikicchā, saṅkā
67470.commentary: (SNPa) sabbakilesabyādhivūpasamanato paññā cikicchitan'ti vuccati, taṃ paññācikicchitaṃ ito vigataṃ, tato vā paññācikicchitā idaṃ vigatanti vicikicchitaṃ, satthari kaṅkhatī'ti-ādinā (dha. sa. 1008, vibha. 915) nayena vuttāya aṭṭhavatthukāya vimatiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tassā pahīnattā sabbavicikicchitāni pahīnāni honti. tañ'hi n'esaṃ mūlaṃ.

67471.construction:
vi + cikiccha + ita + ā
vicikicchita + ā

examples.text: sahā'v'assa dassanasampadāya, tayassu dhammā jahitā bhavanti, sakkāyadiṭṭhi vicikicchitañ'ca, sīlabbataṃ vā'pi yadatthi kiñci.
alañ'hi vo, kālāmā, kaṅkhituṃ alaṃ vicikicchituṃ
alañ'hi te, vaccha, kaṅkhituṃ, alaṃ vicikicchituṃ. kaṅkhanīye ca pana te ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannā.

67473.construction:
vi + cikiccha + ā + ī
vicikicchā + ī
67473.commentary: (MNa) kaṅkhī vicikicchī'ti ettha ekam'ev'idaṃ pañcamaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ. (ANa) vicikicchī'ti vicikicchāya samannāgato sāsanasaddhamme na niṭṭhaṃ gato, uggahaparipucchāvasena niṭṭhaṃ gantuṃ na sakkoti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati. tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rog'ātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti, kaṅkhī vat'amhi vicikicchī aniṭṭhaṅ'gato saddhamme'ti.
ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kaṅkhī vicikicchī araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, kaṅkhivicikicchisandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.
seyyathā'pima gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā sālīnaṃ odano vicitakāḷako anekasūpo anekabyañjano

67477.meaning1: (of rice) with black grains picked out

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnaṃ ce'pi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, n'ev'assa taṃ hoti antarāyāya.

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā parisuddhā pariyodātā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā sālīnaṃ odanaṃ vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ racayitvā aññissā kaṃsapātiyā paṭikujjitvā antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ.
evaṃ pabbajito c'āhaṃ, na cirena bahussuto, ahosiṃ dhammakathiko, vicittapaṭibhāṇavā.
vicittavatth'ābharaṇā, āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā, kusalā naccagītassa, sakkassa paricārikā.

67480.commentary: (MNa) vicittaṃ mālaṃ gantheyyā'ti sayam'pi dakkhatāya pupphānam'pi nānāvaṇṇatāya ekatovaṇṭik'ādi-bhedaṃ vicitramālaṃ gantheyya.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, nānāpupphānaṃ mahāpuppharāsi, tam'enaṃ dakkho mālākāro vā mālākār'antevāsī vā vicittaṃ mālaṃ gantheyya.
purimen'ev'āhaṃ, bhante, opammena bhagavato attamano abhiraddho. api c'āhaṃ imāni bhagavato vicitrāni pañhapaṭibhānāni sotu'kāmo, ev'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paccanīkaṃ kātabbaṃ amaññissaṃ
yo n'ājjhagamā bhavesu sāraṃ, vicinaṃ puppham'iva udumbaresu, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

67485.synonym: upaparikkhanta, pavicinanta, vīmaṃsamāna, volokenta, samannesanta, samannesamāna, samanvesanta

examples.text: etañ'ca dhammam'aññāya, vicinaṃ bhikkhu sadā sato sikkhe, santī'ti nibbutiṃ ñatvā, sāsane gotamassa na pamajjeyya.
vicinanto tadā dakkhiṃ, dutiyaṃ sīlapāramiṃ, pubbakehi mah'esīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.
sabbe saṅgamma mantetvā, māḷaṃ kubbanti satthuno, ekatthambhaṃ alabhantā, vicinanti brahāvane.
ayya sumedhatāpasa, porāṇakabodhisattānaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, pāramiyo vicinissāmā'ti nisinnakāle yāni pubbanimittāni nāma paññāyanti, tāni sabbāni'pi ajja pātubhūtāni

67488.commentary: (SNa) vacināti mukhena so kalin'ti, so taṃ aparādhaṃ mukhena vicināti nāma.

examples.text: yo nindiyaṃ pasaṃsati, taṃ vā nindati yo pasaṃsiyo vicināti mukhena so kaliṃ, kalinā tena sukhaṃ na vindati.

67489.synonym: upaparikkhati, upavicarati, tīreti, paṭivicarati, pavicarati, pavicinati, passati, vicāreti, vīmaṃsati, voloketi, samannesati, samanvesati

examples.text: tasmā hi paṇḍito poso, sampassaṃ attham'attano, yoniso vicine dhammaṃ, evaṃ tattha visujjhati.
sace tattha āgacchati so vattabbo, āvuso, kīdisaṃ te bhaṇḍan'ti? sace rūpena vā nimittena vā sampādeti dātabbaṃ, no ce sampādeti, vicināhi āvuso'ti vattabbo.

67490.commentary: (THa) vicinī'ti esanto'va tattha tattha saṅkārakūṭ'ādike paṃsukūl'uppattiṭṭhāne vicini. (BVa) vajir'ūpaman'ti vajirasadisaṃ tikhiṇaṃ, anicc'ānupassan'ādikassa vipassanāñāṇass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tena vicini saṅkhāre'ti tena vipassanāñāṇena rūp'ādike saṅkhāre vicini. ukkujjam'avakujjakan'ti saṅkhārānaṃ udayañ'ca vayañ'ca vicinī'ti attho.

examples.text: vicinī aggahī dhovi, rajayī dhārayī muni, paṃsukūlāni matimā, anuruddho anāsavo.
tattha ñāṇavar'uppajji, anantaṃ vajir'ūpamaṃ, tena vicini saṅkhāre, ukkujjam'avakujjakaṃ.
idha vassaṃ vasissāmi, idha hem'antagimhisu, iti bālo vicinteti, antarāyaṃ na bujjhati.
